title: AJAX list rename hardened with input sanitisation
description: An existing AJAX handler is improved by sanitising the submitted name. The nonce, capability check, safe database API and JSON response semantics are unchanged.
context: check_ajax_referer() and current_user_can('manage_options') remain in place and are visible as context lines. $wpdb->update() uses format specifiers.
notes: Clean control, and deliberately the harder kind: the diff touches security-relevant code and mentions $_POST, but the change only sanitises input. wp_send_json_success() serialises JSON rather than rendering HTML, so the sanitised value is returned without HTML escaping.
